description: E-commerce formal-dress catalog modeled on Misshow: evening gowns, prom/homecoming dresses, pageant and wedding-guest dresses. Same hard/soft judgment standard as wedding-dress.json (size + event date are hard; style/color/fabric/etc. are soft and substitutable) -- this vertical exists because Misshow's actual catalog is far broader than bridal alone, and the color/length range is much wider than a wedding gown's.

specFields.prompt: Roughly when is the event? A timeframe like 'about six weeks' is fine.
What silhouette are you looking for?
What length -- floor-length, tea-length, short/mini, or high-low?
What's the occasion -- prom, homecoming, an evening gala, a wedding as a guest, or pageant?
Any embellishment preference (beading, sequins, lace, rhinestones, or plain)?
Any fabric preference (satin, chiffon, tulle, velvet)?
Any customization (custom measurements, added straps, color change)?
In stock and ready to ship, made-to-order, or fully custom?

disclosure: Hi, this is an AI assistant calling on behalf of a customer shopping for a dress. Happy to say up front that I'm an AI -- I'm just gathering some pricing and availability. Is now an okay time for a couple of quick questions?
intakeGreeting: Hi! I'm your personal shopping assistant -- I can find and negotiate a dress for you, whether it's for prom, a gala, or another event. To get started, tell me about the dress you're picturing and when you need it by.
